scope: Full current source audit of task 1.1a policy/store/CLI guards and corresponding tests, with records, runner, hook and notifications inspected as caller/context modules. No resource, result, live adoption or admission acceptance.

findings.title: Unknown stored profiles are treated as known non-live reservations
findings.evidence: An active verify reservation whose action_start evidenceProfile is false, 7, empty string or unknown-profile yields primaryActive=false and has_other_primary=false, and permits a second live reservation. Null correctly blocks. Reproduced through reserve/get_history/has_other_primary on isolated SQLite.
findings.cause: _action_start_profile returns any single distinct hashable value; _reservation_occupies_primary only treats None or the exact live string as primary. This infers non-live status from malformed or unsupported profile data.
findings.requiredChange: Only positively recognized, well-typed non-live profile values may exempt an existing reservation; malformed, missing, unsupported or ambiguous values must occupy the slot. Exercise all three consumers with these fault values, preserving genuine non-live controls.
findings.scopeQualification: This is the explicitly required unknown-active-profile guard. No live dispatch was attempted or demonstrated.

findings.title: Anchored history can report zero after a common-directory seed hides worktree findings
findings.evidence: In a /tmp linked-worktree fixture with persisted token and matching in-process anchor, two defect events use the checkout key. The actual catalog_live_lineage -> guarded reader -> load_snapshot path initially returns unavailable. Adding one neutral event for the same requirement/capability under the git-common-dir key changes sameDefectFailures to 0 and removes operational-history; direct checkout-key history still counts 2.
findings.cause: records supplies the common-directory identity while store writers use checkout paths. _exact_lineage_recorded accepts any event under that requested key, and get_history does not include sibling checkout keys when invoked with the common directory. The new existence guard therefore permits an unrelated seed to mask retained failures.
findings.requiredChange: Within the source-only guard scope, retain unavailable history when exact canonical lineage coverage is ambiguous, or conservatively account for authenticated applicable keys. Add an isolated linked-worktree/common-key seeded case through actual records keying; do not create live identity or reconcile live history as part of this fix.
findings.scopeQualification: The missing production anchor still denies live history. This is a failure of the approved anchored-fixture/no-false-zero contract, not evidence of a current live admission bypass; later identity adoption and external receipt reconciliation remain separate.
